name: use-bollard-field
title: useBollardField
description: Library-agnostic React field validation state for Bollard, shadcn/ui, or custom controls. Supports sync and async validation without rendering or styling a component.

meta.summary: Add touched, async-safe validation state and accessible error props to any React control without changing UI libraries.
catches: Validation coupled to a specific input component or UI library
Async responses overwriting the result for a newer value
Inline errors not connected to controls with aria-describedby
Server errors that remain visible after the user edits the field
limits: You provide the validator and render the error message yourself
This hook manages one field; it does not replace form submission or schema validation
Validation runs on blur, then again after edits; call validate() for submit-time checks
a11y: ariaProps connects the control to the error ID and marks invalid state
Render the error with id={field.errorId} and role=alert or aria-live=polite
No focus movement or UI is imposed; the consuming form chooses its summary behavior
